templates.title: Kumbara
templates.name: kumbara
templates.description: Budgeting that files your bank feed for you and opens instantly on your phone.
templates.note: Kumbara pulls your bank transactions through SimpleFIN and files what it recognizes. For the rest it asks once per merchant, and one answer covers every charge from that merchant. Transfers between your own accounts are paired, so they never count as spending. Open http://<server>:5182 after it starts.

env.name: AUTH_PASSWORD
env.label: Password for the app (leave empty for no login)
